title: Crypto Trading Signals - April 23, 2026
top_story_headline: Lido clarifies that only the EarnETH vault is exposed to the Kelp/rsETH incident and, if losses occur, a $3M Lido DAO first-loss buffer will absorb them before impacting depositors.
top_story_comment: Arr, smart of Lido to be clearin' the waters 'bout this Kelp mishap. Good to see they've got a buffer to protect the crew's doubloons if the seas get rough. Still, reminds me why I keep me treasure scattered 'cross different ships!
